items.stem: You need a measure returning sales for the same period last year. Which DAX approach is appropriate?

options.text: CALCULATE([Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date])) with a marked date table
options.rationale: Correct: time-intelligence functions shift the date filter context and need a proper date table.

options.text: A calculated column that subtracts 365 from each date
options.rationale: A column does not respond to report filter context and mishandles leap years.
That is an arbitrary adjustment, not last year's value.

options.text: FILTER the fact table to remove this year
options.rationale: Removing rows does not shift the period to last year.

items.explanation: Correct: time-intelligence functions shift the date filter context and need a proper date table.

items.stem: Which TWO actions improve the performance of a slow report? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Remove unused columns and rows from the model
options.rationale: Correct: reducing model size is named under optimising model performance.

options.text: Use Performance Analyzer to find slow visuals and measures
options.rationale: Correct: Performance Analyzer is the listed diagnostic tool.

options.text: Add more visuals to each page
options.rationale: More visuals usually add more queries.

options.text: Convert every measure to a calculated column
options.rationale: Columns increase model size and do not respond to filters.

items.explanation: Correct: reducing model size is named under optimising model performance.

items.stem: Regional managers must see only their own region's rows in a published report. What do you implement?

options.text: Row-level security roles with group membership
options.rationale: Correct: RLS restricts rows per role; group membership assigns users.

options.text: A separate workspace per manager with copies of the report
options.rationale: Copies multiply maintenance and are not a security model.

options.text: A slicer set to their region
options.rationale: Users can change slicers; it is not security.
Labels classify and protect content but do not filter rows.

items.explanation: Correct: RLS restricts rows per role; group membership assigns users.
